title: Prompt-Payment Credit on the FloodGuard Renewal Premium
content:
Billing department note — the prompt-payment credit on the renewal term premium of the FloodGuard Private Flood Policy.

## Rule

A prompt-payment credit reduces the renewal term premium by 2 percent when no payment on the policy was returned within the 36 months before the date the renewal is recorded and the most recent premium payment was received no later than the due date of the most recent premium charge; by 1 percent when no payment was returned within that window and the most recent premium payment was received after that due date; and by nothing when a payment was returned within that window.

## Records read

- Returned payments: payments on the policy's premium account posted as returned, placed by the date the return was posted.
- The most recent premium payment: the latest payment received on the policy's premium account, by the date it was received.
- The most recent premium charge: the latest premium installment charge posted to the premium account, with the due date it carries.

## Questions answered

Is a payment received on the due date itself on time? Yes; received no later than the due date, it earns 2 percent when no payment was returned in the 36 months.

What if it was received one day after that due date? With no returned payment in the 36 months, the credit is 1 percent.

Does a returned payment remove the credit? Yes, when the return falls within the 36 months before the renewal is recorded; the credit is then nothing, however promptly the latest payment arrived.

Does an older returned payment count? A payment returned 37 months before the renewal is recorded lies outside the window; the credit then turns only on the timing of the most recent premium payment.

## Summary table

| Payment returned within the 36 months | Most recent premium payment against the due date of the most recent premium charge | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| No | On or before the due date | 2 percent |
| No | After the due date | 1 percent |
| Yes | Either | No credit |
